items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee mentions Cozy McRae; the interviewer interjects 'Just like Ron, the bass player' and clarifies 'Ron Carter'. The interviewee does not respond to the mention of Ron or confirm any personal connection.

ctx.x: Use Cozy, because you know why? Cozy was a good studio drummer. He knew -- good tempo man, you know.
Just like Ron, the bass player. He's just a --
